## The Dataset

The [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) dataset contains measurements for `r nrow(penguins_clean)` penguins from three species collected at three islands in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica.

![Artwork by [Allison Horst](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/)](images/lter_penguins.png){width=70% fig-alt="Illustration of the three penguin species: Chinstrap, Gentoo, and Adelie"}

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-4}
### <span class="species-chinstrap">Chinstrap</span>

Named for the thin black line running under their chin. Found exclusively on Dream Island.

- **Count:** `r sum(penguins_clean$species == "Chinstrap")`
- **Islands:** Dream
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### <span class="species-gentoo">Gentoo</span>

The largest of the three species, with distinctive orange bills. Found primarily on Biscoe Island.

- **Count:** `r sum(penguins_clean$species == "Gentoo")`
- **Islands:** Biscoe
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### <span class="species-adelie">Adelie</span>

The most widespread species, found on all three islands. Characterized by shorter bills and moderate body mass.

- **Count:** `r sum(penguins_clean$species == "Adelie")`
- **Islands:** Biscoe, Dream, Torgersen
:::

:::

## Measurements

The dataset includes four key body measurements:

| Measurement | Description |
|---|---|
| **Bill Length** (mm) | Length of the penguin's bill (culmen) |
| **Bill Depth** (mm) | Depth of the penguin's bill |
| **Flipper Length** (mm) | Length of the penguin's flipper |
| **Body Mass** (g) | Weight of the penguin |

![Artwork by [Allison Horst](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/)](images/culmen_depth.png){width=60% fig-alt="Illustration showing how bill length and depth are measured on a penguin"}

## Data Source

Data were collected by [Dr. Kristen Gorman](https://www.uaf.edu/cfos/people/faculty/detail/kristen-gorman.php) at [Palmer Station, Antarctica](https://pallter.marine.rutgers.edu/), and made available through the [palmerpenguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) R package by [Allison Horst](https://allisonhorst.github.io/).
